description: This file defines the Node class representing nodes in a task/activity tree for an Android intent playground. It includes properties, constructors, and methods for managing nodes, copying, comparison, and parcelable serialization.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in the task/activity tree, either a task or an activity, with properties for identifiers, children, intent, and status flags. Implements Parcelable and Comparable.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child node to this node's children list.

methods.name: addFirstChild
methods.description: Adds a child node at the beginning of this node's children list.

methods.name: clearChildren
methods.description: Removes all children from this node.

methods.name: newTaskNode
methods.description: Creates a new task node with a predefined task ID.

methods.name: newRootNode
methods.description: Creates a new root node with a predefined root ID.

methods.name: isModified
methods.description: Checks if this node has been marked as modified.

methods.name: setModified
methods.description: Marks this node as modified or not.

methods.name: isNew
methods.description: Checks if this node is considered new.

methods.name: setNew
methods.description: Marks this node as new or not.

methods.name: isCurrent
methods.description: Checks if this node is marked as current.

methods.name: setCurrent
methods.description: Sets whether this node is current.

methods.name: setIntent
methods.description: Associates an Intent with this node.

methods.name: getIntent
methods.description: Returns the Intent associated with this node.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Determines if this node is structurally equal to another node.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Provides comparison based on task ID or component name for sorting.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the node, including flags and children.

methods.name: writeToParcel
methods.description: Serializes the node into a parcel for IPC or storage.
